node.statement: Multiplicative telescope, conditional on nodes 1.1 and 1.3. Fix n and x,y in M_n tensor B; put b=v_n(x), c=v_n(y), b'=T_n(x), c'=T_n(y). The extended t-isomorphism clause gives ||v_n(xy)-b dot_P c||<=t||x||||y||. Lem-compcb-rectangular-product in A gives ||b dot_P c-bc||<=2*C_co*t||b||||c||, while the ambient product bound and ||b||,||c||<=(1+t) times the source norms give a universal bound ||v_n(xy)||<=K_B||x||||y||. Node 1.1.1 then bounds ||T_n(xy)-v_n(xy)|| by C_nest*K_B*t||x||||y||. By bilinearity, bc-b'c'=(b-b')c+b'(c-c'); the ambient product bound, node 1.3, and the uniform norm bounds control this by K_pert*t||x||||y|| without associativity. Finally b',c' lie in the amplified a-corner, and lem-compcb-rectangular-product inside the extended 2*C_ca*t-C*-algebra A_R gives ||b'c'-b' dot_a c'||<=C_co*(C_nest+2*C_ca)*t||b'||||c'||. The amplified products are exactly these compressed products by lem-compcb-amplified-compression. Summing the four displayed differences gives ||T_n(xy)-T_n(x) dot_a T_n(y)||<=K_M*t||x||||y|| for a universal K_M independent of n and all dimensions.
